title: Dropbox CEO Drew Houston to step down
summary: Dropbox CEO and co-founder Drew Houston announced his resignation, marking a significant leadership transition for the cloud storage company. Ashraf Alkarmi appears to be stepping into a leadership role following Houston's departure.
problem_solved: This news covers a major executive transition in the tech industry, not a technical problem being solved.
why_valuable: The announcement signals a generational shift in tech leadership, as one of Silicon Valley's most recognizable founders steps away from the company he built.
